title: Token usage record — one line of docs/evidence/usage.jsonl
description: Snapshot of model token usage from Claude Code session logs, written by 'evidence.mjs usage' (run at every session start and before collect). One record per session, hour, model and agent; a later record with the same key holds that bucket's running total and replaces the earlier one. Numbers only: no prompts, file names or paths.

session.description: First 12 hex characters of the sha256 of the Claude Code session id.

hour.description: UTC hour the responses were received in.

agent.description: main for the session itself, otherwise the sub-agent type.
